result.description:
SHIPWRIGHT                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Dongara Marine is a leading company in Western Australia’s boat building and maintenance industry. With a highly experienced management team and a skilled, diverse workforce, we deliver a full range of services including new vessel construction, repairs, modifications, and ongoing support for both commercial and government clients.
Following our recent move from Dongara to our purpose-built facility in Geraldton, we are continuing to grow and are looking to strengthen our team with several key roles.
We offer:
Competitive salary – Pay: A$77,000.00 - A$87,000.00 per year. Your skills and experience will be rewarded with an attractive pay package
Job security – join a well-established and forward-thinking company with strong ongoing contracts
Work/life balance – we value our people and promote a healthy balance to ensure you perform at your best
ABOUT US
Fitting out Wheelhouse and Accommodation areas on new vessels and
preparing vessel for launch. Constructing composite superstructures such as wheelhouse, flybridge
on new vessels. Complete maintenance on existing vessels including, refits, windows,
doors, composite repairs etc.
In this role you will be responsible for:

Build and install cabinetry and internal structures
Building, repairing, and modifying boats and marine vessels
Installing ceilings and walls to accommodation area
Installing ceilings to wheelhouse area
Installing furniture such as eating areas, kitchen, accomodation and wheelhouse areas
Installing seating
Install windows and structural fittings
Set up and execute large composite infusions
Setup and construct moulds for vessel components
Carry out gel coating and hand laminating.
Interpret drawings.
ABOUT YOU:

Our ideal candidate will meet the following criteria:
Certificate III in Marine Craft Construction or Certificate III in Carpentry/Cabinet Making or 5 years’ experience in a similar position.
Can work within a team.
Can work unsupervised.
Have good written and verbal communication skills.
Meet strict deadlines.
Sound time management and people skills.
Dongara Marine believes that its greatest asset is its people and, as an Equal Opportunity Employer, encourages applications from individuals from diverse backgrounds.
